articles.title: Trump Says Saudi Arabia Must Make Friends with Israel to Get a Nuclear Deal
articles.summary: President Trump says Saudi Arabia can only get help building nuclear power if it joins the Abraham Accords and officially recognizes Israel. The deal is about peaceful energy, not bombs.

articles.title: Why Is the Government Hiding Bike Safety Info?
articles.summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation is removing bike safety guides and crash tools from its websites, calling some bike lanes "DEI." Safety experts say this could make roads more dangerous.

articles.title: Oil Prices Hit $100 Again—Here's Why It Matters to You
articles.summary: Oil prices jumped to $100 a barrel after Houthi rebels attacked tankers in the Red Sea. This could make gas, food, and other stuff more expensive for families everywhere.
